# PrimaLumiere

> PrimaLumiere is building Saga: Of People, Through People, a teacher-led classroom tool for colleges and universities in India. Saga is in development and preparing a first pilot.

Saga is designed to let a teacher see what a class understood before the next lecture. Students reason on their phones for as long as the teacher sets. Once it passes an accuracy test, a small AI model on each phone reads the reasoning within the teacher's certified questions, and the teacher sees the class's picture. No student is ranked or scored, and what a student writes stays on their phone.

## Contact
